# NVIDIA Video Effects SDK headers (0.7.6)

Headers and loader proxies from https://github.com/NVIDIA-Maxine/Maxine-VFX-SDK (commit f12bd18, MIT, see LICENSE.txt).
They load `NVVideoEffects.dll` / `NVCVImage.dll` at run time from the NVIDIA Video Effects runtime that the user
installs separately (free "Video Effects SDK redistributable" per GPU generation):
https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/broadcasting/broadcast-sdk/resources/

No NVIDIA binaries or models are part of this repository.
